evals.prompt: We want to add AI summarization to our case management app. What are our options?
evals.expected_output: Agent evaluates multiple AI integration approaches: AI Builder GPT prompts (simplest), Copilot Studio BYOM (conversational), and direct AOAI via Custom API (most flexible). Considers DLP and data residency.
expectations: Agent presents AI Builder GPT prompts as the simplest option for text summarization
Agent presents Copilot Studio BYOM as an option if the summarization is part of an agent/conversational experience
Agent presents direct Azure OpenAI via Custom API or Azure Function as the most flexible option (full control over model, prompts, parameters)
Agent compares the trade-offs: AI Builder (fastest to build, least control) vs direct AOAI (most control, more setup)
Agent considers DLP policy implications (custom connectors and HTTP connector classification)
Agent considers data residency — where the AI model is deployed and where case data is processed
Agent warns against exposing AOAI API keys in client-side code

evals.prompt: Our Power Automate flow needs to classify incoming emails and route to the right queue. How should we implement this?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends AI Builder GPT prompt action in the flow for email classification, considers pre-built models, and warns about token costs at scale.
expectations: Agent recommends AI Builder GPT prompt action within the Power Automate flow as the primary approach
Agent suggests using structured output (JSON mode) for classification results to enable reliable routing logic
Agent may mention pre-built AI Builder models (sentiment analysis, category classification) as simpler alternatives for basic classification
Agent warns about token costs at scale — every email processed consumes AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits
Agent may suggest caching or batching strategies for high-volume email processing
Agent considers the Nov 2026 AI Builder credit sunset and recommends budgeting for Copilot Credits
Agent does NOT recommend a direct AOAI integration for this scenario (AI Builder is simpler and sufficient)
